entries.title: Job 18:1
segments: ¶And Bildad the Shuhite answered and said,

entries.title: Job 18:2
segments: How long will ye hunt for words? Be intelligent, and then we will speak.

entries.title: Job 18:3
segments: Wherefore are we counted as beasts, and reputed stupid in your sight?

entries.title: Job 18:4
segments: Thou that tearest thyself in thine anger, shall the earth be forsaken for thee? and shall the rock be removed out of its place?

entries.title: Job 18:5
segments: ¶Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, and the flame of his fire shall not shine.

entries.title: Job 18:6
segments: The light shall become dark in his tent, and his lamp over him shall be put out.

entries.title: Job 18:7
segments: The steps of his strength shall be straitened, and his own counsel shall cast him down.

entries.title: Job 18:8
segments: For he is sent into the net by his own feet, and he walketh on the meshes;

entries.title: Job 18:9
segments: The gin taketh [him] by the heel, the snare layeth hold on him;

entries.title: Job 18:10
segments: A cord is hidden for him in the ground, and his trap in the way.

entries.title: Job 18:11
segments: ¶Terrors make him afraid on every side, and chase him at his footsteps.

entries.title: Job 18:12
segments: His strength is hunger-bitten, and calamity is ready at his side.

entries.title: Job 18:13
segments: The firstborn of death devoureth the members of his body; it will devour his members.

entries.title: Job 18:14
segments: His confidence shall be rooted out of his tent, and it shall lead him away to the king of terrors:

entries.title: Job 18:15
segments: They who are none of his shall dwell in his tent; brimstone shall be showered upon his habitation:

entries.title: Job 18:16
segments: His roots shall be dried up beneath, and above shall his branch be cut off;

entries.title: Job 18:17
segments: His remembrance shall perish from the earth, and he shall have no name on the pasture-grounds.

entries.title: Job 18:18
segments: He is driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.

entries.title: Job 18:19
segments: He hath neither son nor grandson among his people, nor any remaining in the places of his sojourn.

entries.title: Job 18:20
segments: They that come after shall be astonished at his day, as they that went before [them] were affrighted.

entries.title: Job 18:21
segments: Surely, such are the dwellings of the unrighteous man, and such the place of him that knoweth not *God.
